+def _sse_payload(raw: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    event_start = 0
+    if raw.startswith(":"):
+        comment_lf = raw.find("\n")
+        if comment_lf != -1:
+            event_start = comment_lf + 1
+    if raw.startswith("event:", event_start):
+        event_lf = raw.find("\n", event_start)
+        data_start = event_lf + 1
+        if event_lf != -1 and raw.startswith("data:", data_start):
+            data_lf = raw.find("\n", data_start)
+            if data_lf != -1 and raw[data_lf + 1 :] in ("\n", "\r\n"):
+                data_end = data_lf - 1 if raw[data_lf - 1] == "\r" else data_lf
+                data_text = raw[data_start + 5 : data_end].strip()
+                try:
+                    parsed = json.loads(data_text) if data_text else {}
+                    return parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {"value": parsed}
+                except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                    return {"raw": data_text}
+
+    data_parts: list[str] = []
+    start = 0
+    raw_len = len(raw)
+    while start < raw_len:
+        next_lf = raw.find("\n", start)
+        next_cr = raw.find("\r", start)
+        if next_lf == -1:
+            end = next_cr
+        elif next_cr == -1:
+            end = next_lf
+        else:
+            end = next_cr if next_cr < next_lf else next_lf
+        if end == -1:
+            line = raw[start:]
+            start = raw_len
+        else:
+            line = raw[start:end]
+            start = end + 1
+            if raw[end] == "\r" and start < raw_len and raw[start] == "\n":
+                start += 1
+        if line.startswith("data:"):
+            data_parts.append(line[5:].strip())
+    if not data_parts:
+        return None
+    data_text = "\n".join(data_parts)
+    try:
+        parsed = json.loads(data_text) if data_text else {}
+        return parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {"value": parsed}
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return {"raw": data_text}
+
